translation: a. 无所不在的, 到处存在的, 普遍存在的
definition: s being present everywhere at once

translation: n. 到处存在, 普遍存在
definition: n. the state of being everywhere at once (or seeming to be everywhere at once)
n. any of several quinones found in living cells and that function as coenzymes that transfer electrons from one molecule to another in cell respiration
